lines.en: : You are not the maid I asked for or wanted.
lines.zh: : 你不是我点名的、也不是我想要的女仆。

lines.en: : Tough shit, because I’m the maid you got. You think I’m any happier about this than you are?
lines.zh: : 倒霉了吧,因为你摊上的女仆就是我。你以为我就比你高兴?

lines.en: : You should be, as I’m pretty sure that’s what you’re being paid for.
lines.zh: : 你应该高兴,因为我相当确定,这就是你拿工资要干的事。

lines.en: : Bite me.
lines.zh: : 咬我啊。

lines.en: : Here is my first command. I demand a shorter maid whose name starts with the letter “U” and ends with “ta-chan.”
lines.zh: : 这是我的第一道命令。我要求换一个更矮的女仆,名字以字母 U 开头、以 ta-chan 结尾。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Master! But little ole’ U-to the-ta-chan’s totally booked up at the moment! Can’t you do her a big favor and settle for Osako-chan just this once?
lines.zh: : 十分抱歉,Master!但小小的 U-ta-chan 现在的档期完全排满了!你就不能帮人家一个大忙,就这一次将就一下 Osako-chan 吗?

lines.en: : So long as she’s wearing that uniform, you don’t have to worry about her putting you in an ankle lock or whatever the heck it is they do in karate.
lines.zh: : 只要她还穿着那身制服,你就不用担心她给你来个脚踝锁,或者空手道里那些鬼名堂。

lines.en: : Is that true, Osako? Am I safe here?
lines.zh: : 是真的吗,Osako?我在这儿安全吗?

lines.en: : Depends on how many of my buttons you manage to push.
lines.zh: : 取决于你能按响我多少个按钮。

lines.en: : Which ones am I allowed to push?
lines.zh: : 哪些是允许我按的?

lines.en: : Not whichever one you’re trying to push right now.
lines.zh: : 就不是你现在正试图按的那个。

lines.en: : Jeez. Get a room, why don’t ya?
lines.zh: : 哎哟。你们俩怎么不开个房间去?

lines.en: I wind up at the maid cafe- a place I probably wouldn’t have bothered coming to if I had known I was going to be partially ignored by my favorite employee.
lines.zh: 我最后还是来了女仆咖啡厅——如果早知道会被自己最喜欢的店员部分性无视,我大概根本懒得来。

lines.en: Please don’t tell Ami I said that.
lines.zh: 请别告诉 Ami 我说过这话。

lines.en: Anyway, due to word finally starting to get around about this place and the increase of business brought on by summer, I have found myself in the company of another employee who, while good, is no Uta-chan.
lines.zh: 总之,由于这个地方终于开始口口相传、加上夏天带来的生意增长,我发现自己身边换了另一位店员。她不差,但绝不是 Uta-chan。

lines.en: Thankfully, I don’t think I’ll have to deal with her for very long as the cafe should be closing in about thirty minutes or so.
lines.zh: 好在,我想不用跟她周旋太久,咖啡厅大约三十分钟后就该打烊了。

lines.en: Which is just enough time for me to test this maid’s abilities and see how much she has grown now that she has accepted this as a second near full-time job.
lines.zh: 这个时间刚好够我考一考这位女仆的本事,看看她把这里当成第二份准全职工作之后,成长了多少。

lines.en: Even if it’s a job I’m pretty sure she’s only keeping to satisfy some sort of sexual desire.
lines.zh: 尽管我相当确定,她留在这份岗位上,只是为了满足某种性欲。

lines.en: : You know, I haven’t heard you call me “Master” today. Do I need to file a formal complaint?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,今天我还没听你叫过我「Master」。需要我提交一份正式投诉吗?

lines.en: : Do I need to formally file my foot in your ass?
lines.zh: : 需要我正式把我的脚归档进你的屁股吗?

lines.en: She fails the maid test almost immediately.
lines.zh: 她几乎立刻就没通过女仆测试。

lines.en: : Can you at least do the thing?
lines.zh: : 那你至少会做那个吗?

lines.en: : What thing?
lines.zh: : 哪个?

lines.en: : The thing Uta-chan does to make sure my food tastes delicious.
lines.zh: : Uta-chan 做的那个、用来确保我的饭变好吃的动作。

lines.en: : The flavor beam?
lines.zh: : 美味光线?

lines.en: : Yeah. Not to be confused with the death beam- another move I have recently learned that she has.
lines.zh: : 对。别和死亡光线搞混了——那是我最近才得知她会的另一招。

lines.en: : Bzzzzzt.
: Your food tastes better now.
lines.zh: : 你的饭现在变好吃了。

lines.en: : You don’t even have a cool rhyme to go along with it?
lines.zh: : 你连配套的帅气押韵台词都没有?

lines.en: : Man, I brought you your damn omelet. Do you really have to spend the rest of your time here trying to get a rise out of me?
lines.zh: : 大哥,我把你那该死的蛋包饭端来了。你真要把我在这儿剩下的时间都用来惹我炸毛吗?

lines.en: : I know it might seem like that’s my goal here, but what I’m really trying to do is help you. You know, like how you help me with karate.
lines.zh: : 我知道看起来像那样,但我真正想做的其实是帮你。你知道的,就像你帮我练空手道那样。

lines.en: : You have made a total of two or three attempts out of what feels like thousands to actually learn anything inside of the dojo.
lines.zh: : 在道场里,你感觉有几千次机会,实际认真学东西的次数加起来一共两三次。

lines.en: : And you’ve made how many attempts here?
lines.zh: : 那你在这儿又尝试过几次?

lines.en: : I make plenty of attempts with the other guests. There’s just something about the idea of acting that way to you that makes me throw up in my mouth a little.
lines.zh: : 我对别的客人可是尝试得很多。只是一想到要对你也来那套,我就有点想吐。

lines.en: : If you’re a decent maid when it comes to everyone else, how come I’m the only one you’re serving right now while Uta-chan is busy with literally every other table?
lines.zh: : 既然你对别人都是个合格的女仆,那为什么现在只有我在你手里,而 Uta-chan 忙着照看字面意义上的其余每一桌?

lines.en: : Just because I’m okay doesn’t mean I can compete with somebody who’s not only way younger, but way more experienced when it comes to this sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 我算「还行」,不代表我能和那种人竞争——不仅年轻得多,在这种事情上的经验也丰富得多。

lines.en: : If I was still a teenager, I guarantee you I’d have more than one table right now. But unfortunately,  life has gone on for me and I must now deal with customers like you who only want cutesy girls.
lines.zh: : 我要是还是个十几岁的小姑娘,我保证现在手里绝不止一桌。可惜,我的人生已经往前走了,如今只能应付你这种只想要可爱少女的客人。

lines.en: : You’re cute in your own way.
lines.zh: : 你有你自己可爱的方式。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? And what way is that?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗?哪种方式?

lines.en: : The way that if I ignore your face and only look at your body, I can pretend that you’re still just as young as Uta.
lines.zh: : 就是那种,只要我无视你的脸、只看你的身体,就能假装你还和 Uta 一样年轻的方式。

lines.en: : You need professional help.
lines.zh: : 你需要专业治疗。

lines.en: : What I need is a better maid.
lines.zh: : 我需要的是一个更好的女仆。

lines.en: : Are you two in love yet? Or is Osako-chan still a full fledged lesbian?
lines.zh: : 你们俩恋爱了吗?还是 Osako-chan 依然是彻头彻尾的蕾丝边?

lines.en: : Still a lesbian, but thanks for checking. Especially since everyone knows that’s the sort of thing that can just change whenever I want it to.
lines.zh: : 依然是蕾丝边,谢谢关心。尤其是所有人都知道,那种东西随时想变就能变。

lines.en: : If Uta-chan can train herself to stop being sexually attracted to sea creatures, I believe that anything is possible.
lines.zh: : 既然 Uta-chan 都能把自己训练到不再对海洋生物产生性趣,我相信一切皆有可能。

lines.en: : To...what?
lines.zh: : 对……什么?

lines.en: : So anyway! Ignoring what Sensei just said, do you want to actually come to karaoke after work today?
lines.zh: : 总之!无视 Sensei 刚说的话,你今天下班后要不要真的来唱卡拉 OK?

lines.en: : You made the mistake of telling me Miss Watabe is feeling under the weather earlier, so you have no excuse to back out on me this time!
lines.zh: : 你之前犯了个错,告诉我 Watabe 老师身体不舒服,所以这次你别想找借口放我鸽子!

lines.en: : Is caring for my ailing girlfriend not good enough of an excuse?
lines.zh: : 照顾我生病的女朋友,这借口还不够好吗?

lines.en: : Not when there are songs that need to be sung, it’s not! My grandpa that I used to care for would agree with me if he could but, unfortunately, he-
lines.zh: : 只要还有歌等着人唱,就不够!我以前照顾过的爷爷要是能说话肯定站我这边,但可惜,他——

lines.en: : Yup. He’s dead. You don’t have to remind me every shift, you know.
lines.zh: : 对。他死了。你不用每个班次都提醒我一遍,知道吗。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t bother inviting Osako. She’s made it clear that she’s already past the prime of her life and can’t really do what young people do anymore.
lines.zh: : 我看就别麻烦请 Osako 了。她已经明确表示自己早就过了人生巅峰,年轻人的活动是真做不动了。

lines.en: : I’m still younger than you, you know! Stop making it sound like I’m on my death bed just because I mentioned being pretty and perkier during my high school years!
lines.zh: : 我可还比你年轻呢!我只是提了句高中时又漂亮又有活力,你就别把我说得像躺在临终病床上一样!

lines.en: : Do you want to come too, Sensei? The more the merrier! Plus, having a chaperone might prevent the two of us from winding up on the floor again!
lines.zh: : Sensei 你也来吗?人越多越开心!再说,有个监护人在场,说不定能防止我们俩再一次滚到地板上去!

lines.en: : You’re so much better than him. Why would you ever put yourself in a situation where he can tackle you to the ground?
lines.zh: : 你比他好那么多。何苦把自己放到一个能被他扑倒在地的境地?

lines.en: : What if I’m the one who tackled him?
lines.zh: : 要是扑倒他的人是我呢?

lines.en: : That-
: Actually, that tracks. I’ve seen firsthand how weak this guy is. I think Uta could probably take you down on a good day.
lines.zh: : 其实,这倒说得通。这家伙有多弱我亲眼见过。状态好的话,我觉得 Uta 大概都能撂倒你。

lines.en: : I don’t really understand why she would when she’s like four leagues ahead of you, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我真不理解她为什么要那么做——她都领先你大概四个级别了。

lines.en: : Uta-chan, I don’t want Osako-chan to come to karaoke with us. She’s really killing the vibe right now.
lines.zh: : Uta-chan,我不想让 Osako-chan 和我们一起去唱卡拉 OK。她现在真的很杀气氛。

lines.en: : If you’re trying to sound young, it’s not working.
lines.zh: : 如果你想显得年轻,那没用。

lines.en: : You’re one to talk, being so far out of your prime and all.
lines.zh: : 你也好意思说,自己早就过了巅峰期什么的。

lines.en: : Master, you’re going to have to speak a little louder if you want grandma Osako to hear you. Her ears ain’t what they used to be.
lines.zh: : Master,你要是想让 Osako 老奶奶听见你,得再大声一点。她的耳朵不比当年了。

lines.en: : Screw it! You want me to come?! Fine! I’ll show both of you I‘m still young at heart! And when I’m done with that, I’ll work on stealing some of your regular customers!
lines.zh: : 豁出去了!你们想让我去?!好!我就让你们俩看看,我的心依然年轻!等干完这个,我再顺手抢走你们几个常客!

lines.en: : Just because I’m not your age anymore doesn’t mean I’m invalid! There’s still demand for people like me!
lines.zh: : 就算我不在你们的年纪了,也不代表我失效了!像我这样的人依然有市场!

lines.en: : Maybe at the local retirement home.
lines.zh: : 也许在本地的养老院。

lines.en: : Again, I am younger than you!
lines.zh: : 我再说一遍,我比你年轻!

lines.en: : Yeah, but Sensei passes the vibe check. And the only kinda vibe Osako-chan knows is the one she uses on Miss Watabe.
lines.zh: : 是啊,但 Sensei 通过了氛围测试。而 Osako-chan 唯一会的那种氛围,是她用在 Watabe 老师身上的那种。

lines.en: : That’s it! Osako-chan, special move! Double-fisted death beam!
lines.zh: : 受够了!Osako-chan,必杀技!双拳死亡光线!

lines.en: : Osako-chan, no! You’re still not ready! You could hurt yourself!
lines.zh: : Osako-chan,不要!你还没准备好!会伤到自己的!

lines.en: : Those aren’t even fists.
lines.zh: : 那根本不是拳头。

lines.en: : Shut up, shut up, shut up! Just die already!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴闭嘴闭嘴!赶紧去死吧!

lines.en: Uta and I manage to survive the double-fisted death beam (With no actual fists involved) and make it through the rest of the shift without issue.
lines.zh: Uta 和我成功躲过了双拳死亡光线(并没有实际的拳头参与),并且平安度过了剩下的班次。

lines.en: And, being dead set on proving that she is not a “grandma” like Uta suggested, Osako remains true to her word and joins the two of us for a trip to the karaoke bar once the maid cafe closes.
lines.zh: 而且,一门心思要证明自己不是 Uta 口中的「老奶奶」,Osako 说到做到——女仆咖啡厅一打烊,就和我们一起去了卡拉 OK。

lines.en: Upon arrival, Uta books us a room and, before Osako and I are even able to sit down, she has already booted up the machine and begun singing her first song...
lines.zh: 到了之后,Uta 订了个包间,还没等我和 Osako 坐下,她已经开着机器唱起第一首歌了……

lines.en: : I barely know any of these songs.
lines.zh: : 这些歌我几乎一首都不认识。

lines.en: : Nothing from back when you were young?
lines.zh: : 没有你年轻时候的歌?

lines.en: : You mean less than ten years ago? Not sure.
lines.zh: : 你是说不到十年前?不好说。

lines.en: : I might recognize some of them if I got to listen to them first but, based on titles alone, I don’t really recognize any of these.
lines.zh: : 要是先让我听一遍,也许能认出几首。但光看歌名,这些我基本一首都对不上号。

lines.en: : Not a music person?
lines.zh: : 不怎么听歌?

lines.en: : Not really. All my free time in high school went toward karate. And all my free time in college went toward Wakana- who isn’t much of a music person either.
lines.zh: : 算不上。我高中的全部空闲时间都给了空手道。大学的全部空闲时间都给了 Wakana——她也不怎么听歌。

lines.en: : We never really did stuff like this. That was more of a...popular girl sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 我们从来没玩过这种东西。那更像……受欢迎的女孩才会干的事。

lines.en: : Neither one of you strike me as the “popular” type, so that makes sense.
lines.zh: : 你们俩看起来都不是「受欢迎」那一型的,所以合理。

lines.en: : Yeah...well you don’t seem like you were all that popular either, smartass.
lines.zh: : 是啊……你看起来当年也不是多受欢迎,贫嘴精。

lines.en: : Guess you’re right, though. I was never unpopular or anything. I actually had a good amount of friends in high school, but they were all, like...club friends. Not people I spent any free time with.
lines.zh: : 不过你说得也对。我倒也不算不受欢迎。高中时我朋友其实不少,但都是那种……社团朋友。不是空闲时会一起混的人。

lines.en: : College was totally different. As soon as I started seeing Wakana, I barely even talked to anyone else anymore. But I never really cared about that since I had her.
lines.zh: : 大学就完全不同了。一和 Wakana 开始交往,我几乎就不再和别人说话。但我从来没在乎过,因为我有她。

lines.en: : Probably goes without saying, but she was always a bit of an outcast. You can’t really look the way she does and expect not to be.
lines.zh: : 这大概不用多说,但她一直有点像个边缘人。长成她那样,就别指望不是。

lines.en: : But one of my favorite things about her is...that never really seemed to be an issue for her.
lines.zh: : 但我最喜欢她的一点就是……这对她来说,好像从来都不是个问题。

lines.en: : She did what she wanted and didn’t care about what anyone else had to say about it.
lines.zh: : 她想做就做,别人说什么她根本不在乎。

lines.en: : I still love watching her do that today. And I love how...non-judgemental she is when anyone else wants to do their own thing as well.
lines.zh: : 直到今天,我依然爱看她那么做。也爱她那种……不带评判——当别人也想做自己的事时。

lines.en: : She judges me all the time.
lines.zh: : 她可是天天评判我。

lines.en: : You’re a grown man hanging out with teenage girls. She’d be a bad person if she didn’t judge you for that.
lines.zh: : 你是个和十几岁女孩们厮混的成年男人。她要是不因此评判你,那她才是个坏人。

lines.en: : But if you randomly took up some niche hobby like...painting models or articulating animal skeletons, I doubt she’d think you’re weird for it.
lines.zh: : 但你要是随便捡个小众爱好,比如……画模型,或者把动物骨架拼接成型,我怀疑她根本不会觉得你怪。

lines.en: : Actually, she’d probably like the skeleton one. That seems like a very Wakana thing.
lines.zh: : 其实,她说不定会喜欢骨架那个。那听起来就很有 Wakana 风格。

lines.en: : Do you ever worry that you might be basing too much of your current self on her?
lines.zh: : 你有没有担心过,你现在的自己,太多是建立在她的基础之上?

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思?

lines.en: : It just sounds kind of like you stopped existing as Osako once you met her. Now you’re just Wakana’s Osako.
lines.zh: : 就是说,听起来你遇见她之后,「Osako」这个存在就停止了。现在的你只是「Wakana 的 Osako」。

lines.en: : That’s not true. I still have plenty of interests that I don’t share with Wakana.
lines.zh: : 才不是。我还有很多不与 Wakana 共享的兴趣。

lines.en: : At the same time, though, why would being Wakana’s Osako rather than just Osako be a problem if that’s what makes me happy?
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来,如果「Wakana 的 Osako」就是让我幸福的形态,那不做「单纯的 Osako」又有什么问题?

lines.en: : It’s not at the moment. But if something ever happened to her, what would that mean for you?
lines.zh: : 眼下确实没有。可万一她出了什么事,那对你意味着什么?

lines.en: : Aren’t you afraid of the possibility of losing the one thing that makes you you?
lines.zh: : 难道你不怕吗——怕失去那个让你成为你的东西?

lines.en: : Of course. It’s my greatest fear of all.
lines.zh: : 当然怕。那是我最大的恐惧。

lines.en: : But fear is something that is meant to be confronted, not avoided.
lines.zh: : 但恐惧这种东西,是用来直面的,不是用来躲避的。

lines.en: : I’m not going to change who I am based on “what ifs” when the person I am today, codependent or not, is the happiest version of myself I’ve ever been.
lines.zh: : 我不会因为几个「万一」就改变我是谁——不管依不依赖,今天的我,是迄今最幸福的我自己。

lines.en: : All this...stereotypical “fun stuff” that other people do has just never really been a factor for either one of us. So it’s not like we’re even missing out on anything.
lines.zh: : 别人玩的那些……老一套「有趣的东西」,对我们俩来说,从来就不是什么考量。所以根本谈不上错过了什么。

lines.en: : In a way, the fact that she's always been so focused on living for herself has helped me validate the way I've always felt in the back of my mind.
lines.zh: : 从某种意义上说,她那种一直只为自己而活的专注,反倒帮我确认了我心底一直以来的感受是有道理的。

lines.en: : It was always a little weird to me that I never felt regret or remorse for spending time on my training when others would ask me to come hang out with them.
lines.zh: : 别人约我出去玩的时候,我从不为把时间花在训练上而后悔或内疚——这件事对我自己来说,一直有点怪。

lines.en: : It’s like...I wanted to feel bad since I knew I was letting people down...But I didn’t really have the time to feel bad since it would just distract me.
lines.zh: : 就是……我知道自己让人失望了,按理该难过……但我真的没空难过,因为那只会让我分心。

lines.en: : How is that any different from how you feel now? What changed?
lines.zh: : 那这和你现在的感受有什么不同?什么变了?

lines.en: : What changed is I don’t want to feel bad anymore.
lines.zh: : 变了的是,我不想再难过了。

lines.en: : If somebody gets bogged down by me not coming along with them, that’s on them- not me.
lines.zh: : 如果有人因为我没跟去而郁郁寡欢,那是他们的问题——不是我的。

lines.en: : Parents...friends...family...
lines.zh: : 父母……朋友……家人……

lines.en: : We worry so much about what everyone around us thinks that we often forget to think for ourselves. Life is so much better once you learn to just...leave all that behind.
lines.zh: : 我们太在意周围每个人的想法,以至于常常忘了替自己想一想。一旦你学会干脆……把那些都抛在身后,人生会好过得多。

lines.en: : If that’s true, how come you get so offended every time we make fun of you for not being young anymore?
lines.zh: : 要真是这样,那每次我们取笑你不再年轻,你怎么还那么炸毛?

lines.en: : Because I know you’re wrong and that I could blindfold myself and still kick both of your asses at the same time.
lines.zh: : 因为我知道你们错了,而且就算蒙上眼睛,我也能同时把你们俩揍趴下。

lines.en: : That’s even more worrying since I know there must be at least five blindfolds inside of your apartment.
lines.zh: : 那就更让人担心了——因为我知道你公寓里至少有五条眼罩。

lines.en: : One for every weekday.
lines.zh: : 工作日一天一条。

lines.en: : Aaaand done! Your turn to show off your pipes, Osako. I know that following the great Uta-chan is no easy task, but I’m sure that if you try your best, you-
lines.zh: : 好——了!该你展示歌喉了,Osako。我知道在伟大的 Uta-chan 之后登场不是件容易事,但我相信,只要你尽力,你——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah, yeah. Just shut up and listen, Uta.
lines.zh: : 行行行。闭嘴听着就行,Uta。

lines.en: Osako finally finds a song she recognizes and takes the mic from our self-proclaimed MC’s hands.
lines.zh: Osako 终于找到一首她认得的歌,从我们这位自封 MC 的手里接过麦克风。

lines.en: Before I can blink my eyes, their places are swapped. But instead of my gaze landing on the girl it almost always lands on, it gets caught on a nail hanging off of the main stage.
lines.zh: 眨眼之间,两人的位置已经对调。但我的目光没有落在那个它几乎总是落上的女孩身上,而是被主舞台上垂下的一枚钉子勾住了。

lines.en: And it cuts me deeper than the ones I routinely walk on.
lines.zh: 而它割进我之深,远胜那些我每天踩着走过来的。

lines.en: : Osako, what the heck? This song isn’t fun at all.
lines.zh: : Osako,搞什么?这首歌一点也不欢乐。

lines.en: : Shut up. It’s the only song I recognized the name of and I don’t care if you like it or not.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。这是我唯一认得歌名的歌,你喜不喜欢我无所谓。

lines.en: : It’s not that I don’t like it. It’s just that...well, you know! It seems like something my grandma would sing if she wasn’t knockin’ boots with my grandpa up in Heaven.
lines.zh: : 不是不喜欢。只是……你也知道!这歌像我奶奶会唱的——要是她没在天上和我爷爷那个啥的话。

lines.en: : Just let her sing, Uta. Your songs are always too energetic for me anyway.
lines.zh: : 就让她唱吧,Uta。反正你的歌对我来说总是活力过剩。

lines.en: : Ugh! What’s a girl gotta do to get some excitement up in here?!
lines.zh: : 唉!这地方到底要我怎么做才能嗨起来啊?!

lines.en: Osako takes a deep breath...
lines.zh: Osako 深吸一口气……

lines.en: And then slowly opens her mouth...
lines.zh: 然后缓缓张开嘴……

lines.en: : I'VE HEEEEEARD THERE WAAAAAS A SECRET CHORD!!!!
lines.zh: : 我听————说————有一道神秘的和弦!!!!

lines.en: : THAT DAAAAAAVID PLAYED AND IT PLEEEEEASED THE LORD!
lines.zh: : 大————卫————曾弹奏它,它令主欢——喜!

lines.en: : BUT YOOOOUUUU DON’T REAAAAALY CARE FOR MUSIC...DO YOU?!?!?!?!
lines.zh: : 可你————你其实并不在乎音乐……对吧?!?!?!?!

lines.en: : IT GOOOOOOES LIKE THIS...THE FOURTH...THE FIFTH!!!
lines.zh: : 它是这样走的……第四级……第五级!!!

lines.en: : THE MINOR FALLS, THE MAJOR LIFTS!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 小调坠落,大调扬起!!!!!!!

lines.en: : AND DAA DA DAAA DA DAAA DA HAAAAALLELUUUUUJAH!!!!
: I’ve gotta go return some video tapes.
lines.zh: : 我得去还几盘录像带。

lines.en: : I’ll come with you.
lines.zh: : 我陪你。

lines.en: : HAAAAALLELLUUUUJAH! HAAAAAALLLELUUUU- Wait, where are you guys going? I thought Uta was singing again after this?
lines.zh: : 哈利————路————亚!哈利————路——————等等,你们去哪儿?说好这首之后 Uta 还要再唱的?

lines.en: : Sensei, split up! She can’t catch both of us!
lines.zh: : Sensei,分头跑!她抓不住我们两个的!

lines.en: : Wha-
: Get back here! I haven’t even finished yet!
lines.zh: : 给我回来!我还没唱完呢!

lines.en: Osako’s affection has increased to [osako_love]!
lines.zh: Osako 的好感度提升到了 [osako_love]!

lines.en: Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!
lines.zh: Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]!
